summary: On paper Buffalo has the edge (Buffalo ranks 1st in explosive play rate, 10.1%), while Minnesota's best counter is to win up front (Minnesota's defense ranks 1st in pressure rate, 26% generated). Under center, Josh Allen ranks 7th of 30 in EPA per dropback; x-factor: Khalil Shakir averages 4.4 yards of separation, 2nd of 67, and Minnesota's pass defense ranks 2nd. The model favors Buffalo at 69%, mostly on rushing matchup (4.2 pts) and starting QB (2.4 pts).
